stem.en: An object of mass 2 kg moves at a constant 10 m/s. It enters a rough patch where friction on it is 7 N. At the same time, a constant force of 3 N acts on it against the motion. How far does it go on the patch before it stops, in metres?

explanation.en: Both forces act against the motion: the net force is 7 N + 3 N = 10 N. a = 10 N / 2 kg = 5 m/s², slowing it down. From v² = u² + 2as: 0 = 100 - 2 x 5 x s, so s = 10 m.

hints.en: Add the two forces against the motion. Find a, then use v² = u² + 2as.
